question: What social status does the foremost mantra practitioner attain in all the world?
premises: The practitioner holds or maintains the practice.
The context is all the world.
The foremost mantra practitioner becomes dear to all.
inference: The foremost mantra practitioner certainly becomes dear in all the world.
uncertainties: The object of dhārayati is implicit from context.
plain_english: Holding it, the foremost mantra practitioner certainly becomes dear in all the world.
